headline: Spotify Running Mode helps match tunes to tempo
summary: Spotify introduces a new Running Mode feature. It helps curate playlists based on workout goals, music tastes, and desired BPM. The aim is to make music discovery easier and keep users moving.

headline: Amazon’s short story collections are one of the best reasons to own a Kindle
summary: The author praises Kindle for its convenience and vast library. They highlight Amazon's short story collections as a key benefit. This comes after a personal return to digital reading from physical media.

headline: A second lens makes DJI’s Osmo Pocket 4P my new favorite video camera
summary: DJI's Osmo Pocket 4P adds a second camera lens to the original. The review assesses if the extra lens justifies increased size, weight, and cost. It's compared against competitors like Insta360's Luna Ultra.

headline: SwitchBot makes a better fan
summary: SwitchBot unveils the new Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro. It offers improved battery life, throw distance, and wind speed. The fan also adds native Matter-over-Wi-Fi for smart home integration.

headline: Of Course Jason Momoa's Blanka Does the Electrocution X-Ray Skeleton Attack in the Street Fighter Movie
summary: A new look at the upcoming Street Fighter movie has been released. It showcases a fight scene involving Jason Momoa as Blanka. Blanka performs his signature electrocution X-ray skeleton attack.

headline: After Pathfinder and One of the Best Warhammer 40,000 Games Ever Made, Owlcat's Next Step Is to Top Them All — and It's Grown to 600 People to Do It
summary: Owlcat Games, known for successful RPGs, aims to create their best game yet. The studio has expanded significantly, now employing 600 people. They are striving to surpass their acclaimed Pathfinder and Warhammer 40,000 titles.

headline: EXCLUSIVE: How The Expanse: Osiris Reborn's Progression System Works, Plus Brand New Screenshots
summary: Exclusive details and new screenshots for The Expanse: Osiris Reborn have been revealed. The third-person action RPG has major Mass Effect vibes. Its unique progression system defines combat through gear, not class.

headline: Gears of War: E-Day Multiplayer – The First Preview
summary: A first preview of the Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer beta is out. Xbox's long-running shooter series is introducing smart gameplay changes. Initial impressions are based on roughly 10 hours of gameplay.

headline: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
summary: The US has launched 'heavy' strikes against Iran. This action follows an attempted attack on American troops. Hostilities have resumed after a brief period of calm.

headline: Thousands evacuated in Crete as Europe battles wildfires
summary: Thousands of residents have been evacuated in Crete due to raging wildfires. Strong winds are exacerbating the situation in the Rethymno region. Wildfires continue to devastate parts of the Greek island.

headline: Large rise in offenders sent back to prison, figures reveal
summary: New figures indicate a significant increase in prison recalls. More offenders are being sent back to prisons in England and Wales. This trend raises concerns about reoffending rates.

headline: Watch: Giant iceberg turns over near Greenland's coast
summary: A giant iceberg dramatically overturned near Greenland's coast. The event was captured on video by a passerby. Its collapse created a massive wave.
